title: Editorial Content Release Bundle (M3)
description: M0's signed editorial bundle plus the two reviewed content classes the deterministic assembler cannot run without. Every unchanged object type is referenced from the M0 document by absolute $id rather than restated, so the frozen shapes stay single-sourced. Two additions. (1) timing_template: a timing paragraph asserts calculated dates in words, and without a reviewed template it was a facts-only exception to the rule that every paragraph resolves to an approved content version. (2) daily_fallback: safety_rules.minItems 1 proves a validator rule exists, not that any rule applies to the requested locale or that its referenced fragment is eligible with no facts — and since most days have no cycle inside orb, the fallback is the commonest path, not the exceptional one.

timingPlaceholder.description: Closed placeholder set. The renderer fills these with locale-formatted calculated values and nothing else: no executable expression, no free-form interpolation, no nested template.

template_text.description: Reviewed copy containing only {placeholder} tokens drawn from the declared placeholders array.

is_locale_default.description: Exactly one approved default per supported locale. Ingestion rejects a release without one as timing_template_missing_for_locale.

fallbackCopyObject.description: The reviewed copy published when nothing survives eligibility or a required validation check rejects the draft. Its schema permits NO required fact class, body, aspect, technique, house, context signal, or minimum accuracy above unknown, and it cannot delegate to a cycle or phase fragment — a fallback that can itself be ineligible is not a fallback.

eligibility_mode.description: The only permitted value. There is no eligibility block on this object at all: not an empty one, which a later edit could fill.

bundle_hash.description: Hash of the canonical bundle body excluding signature, under the repository's legacy canonicalJson procedure. M3 does NOT reinterpret this as RFC 8785.

supported_locales.description: New in M3 and required. Every entry must have exactly one approved daily_fallback and at least one default timing_template.

locale_default.description: Promoted to required and must be a member of supported_locales, otherwise ingestion rejects the release as locale_default_not_supported. Locale resolution is exact match, then the configured language fallback, then this.

language_fallbacks.description: Explicit locale -> locale map consulted between exact match and locale_default. Explicit rather than inferred from tag prefixes, so 'pt-BR falls back to pt-PT' is an editorial decision and not a string operation.

fixtures.description: Smoke-test fixture ids resolved against contracts/m3/fixtures/assembly/. An id with no catalogue entry is a rejection (fixtures_unknown), never a pass — otherwise a compromised control plane activates a release by naming fixtures nobody has.

contentReleaseBundle.$comment: Policy checks beyond JSON Schema, enforced at ingestion and pinned by invalid fixtures: approver_id != last_author_id; locale_default in supported_locales (locale_default_not_supported); exactly one approved daily_fallback per supported locale (fallback_missing_for_locale, fallback_duplicate_for_locale); every daily_fallback locale in supported_locales (fallback_locale_mismatch); eligibility_mode universal (fallback_not_universal); at least one default timing_template per supported locale (timing_template_missing_for_locale); every template placeholder token declared; phase parent_cycle_id graph resolution; and every declared fixture id present in the catalogue (fixtures_unknown).
